items.title: 上线两月流水破2亿美元，《哈利波特：魔法觉醒》今日官宣停服
items.en_title: After $200M in Two Months, Harry Potter: Magic Awakened Announces Shutdown
items.en_oneliner: With its license agreement expiring, Harry Potter: Magic Awakened will stop top-ups and delist on December 21, 2026, and shut down its servers on March 3, 2027 — a reminder of the lifecycle risks behind licensed-IP games.

items.title: 《足球经理》熬了两年，总算重归正轨
items.en_title: Football Manager Fought Through Two Rough Years and Is Finally Back on Track
items.en_oneliner: After switching to Unity, a cancelled FM25 and a rocky FM26, a conversation with the FM27 team on how the series is finding its footing again.
